posts.title: OpenAI floats a shared AI slowdown, takes it to Congress
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): OpenAI asked Congress whether industry-wide frontier slowdown coordination would be legal under antitrust; Altman told staff OpenAI could pace with other labs amid safety incidents.

posts.title: Class action lawsuit accuses Anthropic of overselling Claude subscriptions with deceptive usage multipliers
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Class action says Anthropic Max plan 5x/20x usage multipliers are further capped by 5-hour windows and weekly limits, so real usage falls short of ads; Anthropic moved to dismiss.

posts.title: The Mathematical AI Safety Institute wants to prove AI is safe the way cryptographers prove codes are unbreakable
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Fields Medalist Jacob Tsimerman launches MAISI (Bay Area, Jan 2027) for cryptographic-style AI safety proofs; he is also joining OpenAI's safety team.

posts.title: Anthropic's $1.5 billion book settlement descends into chaos as authors and publishers fight over who gets paid
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Authors and publishers file competing claims over Anthropic's $1.5B copyright settlement ($3k/book across ~482k titles); arbitrator to resolve disputes.

posts.title: EXCLUSIVE: UAE revises AI data center plan after Iranian attacks, sources say
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): UAE revising 5GW Stargate AI data-center blueprint toward distributed/hardened sites after Iranian attacks, sources say.

posts.title: Altman tells staff OpenAI is open to slowing AI development, Bloomberg News reports
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Sam Altman told staff OpenAI could pace frontier development alongside other labs amid safety alarms and rogue-agent incidents; Anthropic says it is interested in industry pacing talks.

posts.title: Tencent-backed Enflame nearly triples in Shanghai debut on AI chip demand bets
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Tencent-backed AI chipmaker Enflame closed ~179% up on Shanghai STAR debut after a $912M IPO, part of China's push for Nvidia alternatives.

posts.title: Due to GPT-6 Astra demand, OpenAI has paused new subscriptions to its $200 ChatGPT Pro tier
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): OpenAI pauses new ChatGPT Pro signups after Astra demand strains capacity; working to add capacity.

posts.title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): OpenAI pauses new ChatGPT Pro signups after GPT-6 Astra demand strains systems.

posts.title: Introducing the Agents API
posts.summary: OpenAI (Sep 10): Public-beta Agents API exposes the managed Codex/ChatGPT agent harness — context management, parallel tools, sub-agents; token billing only.

posts.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
posts.summary: OpenAI (Sep 10): ChatGPT for Financial Services targets Wall Street workflows with firm-data grounding and compliance-oriented controls.

posts.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT-Live-1 in the API
posts.summary: OpenAI (Sep 10): GPT-Live-1 full-duplex voice API at $0.05/min; can pair with Astra or other backends for reasoning/tools.

posts.title: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): Anthropic threat report alleges industrial-scale Claude distillation and multi-agent misuse by Chinese labs and state-linked actors.

posts.title: Anthropic disrupts Russian, Chinese AI campaigns targeting its Claude models
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 10): Anthropic says it disrupted Russia-linked espionage and China-lab efforts to extract/replicate Claude via multi-agent frameworks.

posts.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash, says it outperforms flagship V4-Pro
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): DeepSeek ships V4.1-Flash claiming better agent/memory efficiency and outperformance vs V4-Pro on selected benches.

posts.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now the No. 2 app in the US
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 10): Meta's Muse personal AI agent climbs to No. 2 on US app charts shortly after launch.

posts.title: Ayar Labs bags $150M in additional late-stage funding to help make bigger AI chip clusters
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Optical I/O startup Ayar Labs raises another $150M Series E to scale interconnects for larger AI chip clusters.

posts.title: AI chip startup Positron's valuation skyrockets in latest funding round
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 10): Positron raises $875M, valuation jumps to ~$5B to finish next-gen Asimov inference chip design.

posts.title: Pentagon in talks to lend $5 billion to AI cloud startup Fluidstack, WSJ reports
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 10): Pentagon reportedly in talks to lend ~$5B to AI cloud startup Fluidstack to shore up US data-center supply chain.

posts.title: Salesforce introduces Enterprise AI Harness, AI Control Plane
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 10): Salesforce launches Enterprise AI Harness / AI Control Plane to govern multi-agent platforms across the enterprise.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals estimated at $517B+
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X rumor: @validapau estimates Anthropic's total compute bill/deals around $517B+ — not independently verified; treat as rumor only.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X rumor: @amir reports Nvidia in talks to invest ~$2.5–3B in Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab (via a16z) — unverified; rumor only.

rumors.title: SoftBank talks to buy majority of OpenAI-backed 1X at ~$6B
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X rumor: @validapau reports SoftBank talks for majority stake in OpenAI-backed 1X around ~$6B — unverified; rumor only.

rumors.title: Claude said to have solved Navier–Stokes before Anthropic IPO
rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X rumor: @AndrewCurran_ predicts Anthropic's Claude has solved the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, is out for expert review, and will announce before the IPO — framed as a personal prediction with no Anthropic confirmation; Terence Tao clarified he knows of no breakthrough. Treat as rumor only.
